confirmed_changes.reason: Of 121 enrolled participants, data from 1 were lost due to computer problems, yielding an analytic sample of 120 across the eight cells of the 2 x 2 x 2 design (corroborated by the Table 1 choice frequencies summing to 120 and the eight-cell ANOVA F(7, 112) = 3.67).
